verdict.rationale: Mollie's Subscriptions API automatically creates recurring payments at a specified interval, building on its recurring-payments flow where the customer completes only the first payment. Idempotency guidance covers subscription double-charge risk, and a separate Magento 2 module adds subscription features. That covers the core of recurring billing, but nothing in the evidence shows plan/price catalogs, trial periods, plan upgrades or downgrades, or proration logic. Developers would likely have to build those themselves. missing for 10: plan/product catalog objects, trial period support, upgrade/downgrade flows, proration calculation, independent corroboration.
